items.q: Barrett oesophagus is histologically defined by replacement of squamous epithelium with what?
items.exp: Barrett requires intestinal metaplasia (goblet cells) in oesophageal biopsies (in most definitions) as the premalignant substrate for adenocarcinoma, arising under chronic reflux injury.
r: Incorrect. Gastric type alone is insufficient in goblet requiring criteria.
Correct. Goblet intestinal metaplasia defines Barrett.
Incorrect. Dysplasia grades within Barrett, not its definition.
Incorrect. Pancreatic heterotopia is a separate incidental rest.
items.kp: Goblet cells above the junction equal Barrett oesophagus.

items.q: Bird beak barium narrowing with dilated oesophagus, retained food and absent peristalsis indicate which motility disorder?
items.exp: Achalasia loses inhibitory myenteric neurons so the lower sphincter fails relaxation with aperistalsis, causing progressive dysphagia to solids and liquids, regurgitation and bird beak tapering, treated by myotomy or dilation.
r: Incorrect. Spasm corkscrews with chest pain and preserved relaxation more.
Correct. Bird beak aperistalsis means achalasia.
Incorrect. Rings cause episodic solid impaction only.
Incorrect. Scleroderma opens sphincter causing reflux opposite pattern.
items.kp: Bird beak plus both solid liquid dysphagia equals achalasia.

items.q: Trypanosoma cruzi (Chagas) destruction of myenteric plexus causes oesophageal disease identical to what?
items.exp: Chagas parasites destroy enteric neurons causing megaesophagus mimicking idiopathic achalasia, megacolon and dilated cardiomyopathy in Latin American epidemiology, a favourite mimic pairing.
r: Incorrect. Barrett is reflux metaplasia, not neuronal loss.
Correct. Chagas megaesophagus mirrors achalasia.
Incorrect. Cancer risk rises in chronic achalasia, not direct parasitic tumour.
Incorrect. Hypersensitivity lacks dilation neuronal pattern.
items.kp: Chagas thinks achalasia plus megacolon plus bad heart.

items.q: Why must gastric ulcers be biopsied at endoscopy while duodenal ulcers usually are not for cancer?
o: A proportion of gastric ulcers are cancers masquerading as benign ulcers; duodenal ulcers almost never malign
items.exp: Gastric carcinoma can ulcerate mimicking peptic ulcer (and may partially heal on acid suppression), so edges and base need biopsy plus follow up healing proof. Duodenal peptic ulcers essentially never represent cancer.
r: Incorrect. Most gastric ulcers are benign but minority hide cancer.
Correct. Masquerading cancer mandates gastric biopsy.
Incorrect. Duodenal malignancy presenting as peptic ulcer is negligible.
Incorrect. Biopsy diagnoses; acid therapy heals.
items.kp: Gastric ulcer equals biopsy always. Duodenal equals treat and test Helicobacter.

items.q: Helicobacter pylori causes duodenal ulcer chiefly through which antral mechanism?
o: Antral gastritis raising gastrin and acid load with duodenal gastric metaplasia colonisation
items.exp: Antral predominant Helicobacter gastritis disinhibits gastrin driving acid hypersecretion that metaplasias duodenal epithelium toward gastric type, which Helicobacter then colonises ulcerating it. Corpus predominant patterns instead atrophy toward cancer risk.
r: Incorrect. Duodenal colonisation needs gastric metaplasia first.
Correct. Antral gastrin acid axis drives duodenal ulcers.
Incorrect. Prostaglandin loss is NSAID mechanism.
Incorrect. Autoimmune gastritis causes B12 failure separately.
items.kp: Antral Helicobacter raises acid; corpus Helicobacter raises cancer risk.

items.q: Leather bottle stomach (linitis plastica) with signet ring cells indicates which gastric cancer type and adhesion loss?
items.exp: Diffuse gastric cancer discohesive signet ring cells (mucin pushing nucleus aside) infiltrate and fibrose the whole wall into rigid linitis plastica without mass, hereditary when germline CDH1 mutates.
r: Incorrect. Intestinal type forms glands and masses stepwise.
Correct. Signet rings plus leather bottle mean diffuse E cadherin loss.
Incorrect. MALT lymphoma is lymphoid stomach tumour Helicobacter linked.
Incorrect. GIST is mesenchymal KIT driven submucosal tumour.
items.kp: Signet rings thicken stomachs into bottles: diffuse cancer.

items.q: Left supraclavicular node (Virchow) enlargement in gastric cancer is also called what sign and route?
o: Troisier sign via thoracic duct abdominal spread
items.exp: Virchow node (Troisier sign) is left supraclavicular metastasis via thoracic duct from abdominal cancers especially stomach. Sister Mary Joseph is umbilical, Krukenberg ovarian, Blumer rectal shelf deposits, all advanced markers.
r: Incorrect. That is the umbilical nodule eponym.
Correct. Virchow node equals Troisier sign.
Incorrect. Krukenberg names ovarian signet deposits.
Incorrect. Blumer shelf is rectal pouch metastasis palpated.
items.kp: Left neck node from stomach cancer: Virchow Troisier sign.

items.q: MALT lymphoma of stomach is driven by which infection and may regress with its eradication early?
items.exp: Gastric MALT lymphoma arises in Helicobacter acquired lymphoid tissue under chronic antigen drive, and early localised disease regresses after Helicobacter eradication in most cases without chemotherapy, translocation bearing cases excepted.
r: Incorrect. EBV drives Burkitt and nasopharyngeal cancers.
Correct. Eradicate Helicobacter to regress early MALT.
Incorrect. HPV drives oropharyngeal squamous cancers.
Incorrect. HCV links splenic marginal lymphomas differently.
items.kp: Stomach lymphoma that antibiotics can cure early: MALT.

items.q: Mallory Weiss tear versus Boerhaave rupture: Boerhaave is distinguished how?
o: Full thickness oesophageal rupture after vomiting causing mediastinitis and surgical emergency
items.exp: Boerhaave transmurally ruptures distal oesophagus after forceful vomiting (Mackler triad pain, vomiting, emphysema) leaking into mediastinum lethally, while Mallory Weiss is superficial mucosal laceration bleeding self limited usually.
r: Incorrect. That describes Mallory Weiss mucosal tears.
Correct. Transmural rupture mediastinitis means Boerhaave.
Incorrect. Strictures narrow chronically without rupture.
Incorrect. Varices bleed from portal hypertension in cirrhosis.
items.kp: Vomit then chest catastrophe equals Boerhaave until CT clears it.

items.q: Plummer Vinson syndrome triad of iron deficiency, dysphagia and oesophageal webs raises risk of which cancer?
items.exp: Plummer Vinson (Paterson Brown Kelly) webs in iron deficient (often middle aged female) patients predispose to postcricoid and upper oesophageal squamous carcinoma needing surveillance after iron correction.
r: Incorrect. Barrett adenocarcinoma is distal reflux driven.
Correct. Webs predispose upper squamous cancer.
Incorrect. Gastric diffuse follows CDH1 biology unrelated.
Incorrect. The risk is malignant oesophageal, not benign laryngeal.
items.kp: Iron plus webs plus dysphagia: watch the postcricoid region.
